_about: Every NASA dataset the game uses, checked on 2026-11-14. Shown on the Science Sources screen and in README.md. live = the browser calls it during play (1.5 s timeout); saved = real data saved by `npm run fetch-nasa` into src/data/nasa-cache.

sources.name: DONKI — Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information
sources.what: Real solar flares: class (M, X), peak time, source region.
sources.why: Each run's flare is a real flare from the Sun.
sources.game_moment: Solar flare day, debrief card, end screen.
sources.endpoint_status: Works (CORS ok). Note: api.nasa.gov DONKI/FLR answers 404, so the game reads FLR notifications. Needs API-key quota (DEMO_KEY is 10 calls/day per network).

sources.name: InSight Mars weather (NASA InSight lander)
sources.what: Real air temperature, pressure and wind on Mars, sols 675–681 (Oct 2020).
sources.why: Real cold Mars nights for the heaters and the Notebook.
sources.endpoint_status: Works, no key, CORS ok. The mission ended in 2022, so the newest data is from 2020.

sources.name: NASA OSDR RadLab — Curiosity RAD (MSL-RAD-Surface)
sources.what: Real radiation dose rate measured on the Mars surface.
sources.why: Shows how much radiation really reaches Mars.
sources.game_moment: Solar flare day debrief (Radiation on Mars).
sources.endpoint_status: Works from the fetch script. Blocks browser calls (no CORS), so the game uses saved data.

sources.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR)
sources.what: Real plant studies from the space station: OSD-268 (lettuce), OSD-678 (light), OSD-766 (tomatoes).
sources.why: Real space-farming results for the greenhouse.
sources.endpoint_status: Works from the fetch script. Blocks browser calls (no CORS), so the game uses saved data.

sources.name: APOD — Astronomy Picture of the Day
sources.what: NASA's real picture of the day, on the day of the run's flare.
sources.why: A real sky picture for the title and ending.
sources.endpoint_status: Works (CORS ok) but often takes ~4 s, longer than the 1.5 s timeout. Needs API-key quota.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.what: Real photos and videos: solar panels, MOXIE, Veggie, dust storms, flares.
sources.why: Shows the real thing behind each room.

sources.name: NASA Mars Trek
sources.why: Real Mars ground around the base.

sources.name: NASA web pages (facts)
sources.what: Sol length, trip time, thin air, flare sizes, message delay, MOXIE, InSight, Opportunity, space lettuce.
sources.why: Every Notebook fact is checked against its NASA page.
sources.docs_url: src/data/facts.json (source_url + source_date + evidence on every card)
